spacing.$description: Padding, gap and margin scale (4px base, 2px half-steps for micro adjustments).

none.$description: Intentional zero spacing. Collapsing gaps, removing default padding on reset elements.

xxs.$description: Micro adjustments. Notification badge offset, indicator dot position, tight icon nudges.

xs.$description: Icon-to-label gap, tag/badge internal padding, tight chip spacing, button icon gap.

sm.$description: Status pill padding, pagination item padding, vertical tab padding, small control gaps.

md.$description: Table cell padding, button group gap, modal inner gap, list row vertical padding, tooltip padding.

lg.$description: Tab button vertical padding, accordion header padding, form label gap, link group gap.

xl.$description: Tab button horizontal padding, button large padding, notification padding, table cell horizontal padding, form field label gap.

2xl.$description: Button large horizontal padding, section subgroup spacing, comfortable list gaps on tablet.

3xl.$description: Modal padding, card padding, notification horizontal padding, accordion medium gap.

4xl.$description: Section padding, section gap, card lg/md/sm padding on web. Major layout rhythm value.

5xl.$description: Page content top padding, large drawer padding, between-section vertical rhythm on web.

6xl.$description: Accordion medium header gap, large section separators, major vertical rhythm breaks.

7xl.$description: Page header bottom margin, switch description offset, large structural gaps on web.

8xl.$description: Large layout offsets, page-level container padding on wide breakpoints.

9xl.$description: Maximum semantic spacing. Wide-screen page container horizontal padding.

10xl.$description: Radio description indent, structural layout offsets in complex dashboard layouts.

11xl.$description: Maximum layout structural offset. Rare — use only for intentional large structural gaps.

control.$description: Shared control spacing by control size (P-04). Use with size.control.height.*.
